title: 49ers liking what they're seeing of rookie pass rusher Romello Height

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers liking what they're seeing of rookie pass rusher Romello Height
sources.description: Romello Height was already 25 years old when the 49ers drafted him in the third round this year, after a very long college career that saw him initially commit to Miami, then enroll at Auburn, then transfer to USC, transfer again to Georgia Tech, and transfer one final time to Texas Tech.
